title: The Signal Through the Muffling Fog
story: Two young kite-riders are stranded on a thunderhead, and the only way to guide them home is the cliff-top signal lamp. But Vorlaine the Cloud Muffler has spread herself across the sky like grey wool, swallowing most of any light that passes through. Mr 6 climbs to the lamp, wipes the glass with his cape, and starts doing the math instead of just cranking the wick.
question: Vorlaine absorbs 60% of any beam that enters her fog, and 84 candlepower must actually reach the kite-riders. How many candlepower must Mr 6's lamp send out?
solution: If 60% is absorbed, only 100% - 60% = 40% of the beam gets through, so 0.4 of the lamp must equal 84.
The lamp must blaze at 210 candlepower.
praise: Working with the percent was smart thinking — the missing step was using the 40% that gets THROUGH, not the 60% that gets eaten.
hint: If the fog swallows 60%, what percent of the beam actually survives the trip? That surviving part has to equal 84.
victory: Mr 6 cranked the wick to a roaring 210, the beam punched a clean tunnel through the grey, and Vorlaine — suddenly lit up like a lampshade and deeply embarrassed — drifted off to be a very ordinary rain cloud somewhere else.
imagePrompt: A cliff-top signal lighthouse at night firing a brilliant golden beam through a vast sullen grey fog-creature, with two tiny kite-riders silhouetted on a distant thundercloud and a numeral-6 knight in a blue cape turning the lamp's crank.
